name: Henbou Kareshi
source:
"Even though he's so disinterested in love, for just a moment it's like he's been enchanted. It's all because of the perfume I made..."

He's a handsome soushoku danshi who's had a bad experience in love that he's never been able to tell anyone. However, he suddenly turns into a nikushoku danshi!? The perfume I made has a dangerously seductive fragrance. Before we realize it, it's caused him to abandon all reason...

[From Google Play Store]
translation:
“虽然他对爱情那么不感兴趣，但有一瞬间却像是着了魔一样，都是因为我调制的香水……”

他是一位英俊的总食男子，却有着一段无法向任何人诉说的不愉快的恋爱经历。然而，他却突然变成了肉食男子！？我调制的香水有一种危险而诱人的香味。不知不觉间，这让他放弃了一切理智……

[来自Google Play商店]
